allowed_guidelines: One carry-on bag and one personal item are generally allowed per passenger.
Pets in cabin require prior approval and must fit comfortably in an approved carrier under the seat.
Most portable electronic devices with lithium-ion batteries under 100 Wh are permitted in carry-on or checked baggage (with precautions).

faqs.q: What are Delta's carry-on baggage dimensions?
faqs.a: Delta's carry-on baggage must not exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm), including handles and wheels. There is generally no weight limit unless specified for certain international routes.

faqs.q: Can I bring a pet in the cabin on Delta?
faqs.a: Yes, small dogs, cats, and household birds can travel in the cabin on most flights, provided they meet age, health, and destination requirements. The pet carrier must fit under the seat in front of you, with common soft-sided dimensions around 18 x 11 x 11 inches (45.7 x 28 x 28 cm). Prior approval from Delta is required.

faqs.q: What are the rules for batteries on Delta flights?
faqs.a: Spare lithium-ion batteries (up to 160 Wh) must be in carry-on baggage only and protected from short circuit. Batteries over 160 Wh are highly restricted or forbidden. Devices with batteries can be in carry-on or checked baggage, but if in checked baggage, they must be turned off and protected from accidental activation.

faqs.q: Welche Abmessungen gelten für das Handgepäck bei Delta?
faqs.a: Das Handgepäck von Delta darf 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 Zoll) einschließlich Griffe und Rollen nicht überschreiten. Es gibt in der Regel keine Gewichtsbeschränkung, es sei denn, dies ist für bestimmte internationale Strecken angegeben.

faqs.q: Darf ich ein Haustier in der Kabine bei Delta mitnehmen?
faqs.a: Ja, kleine Hunde, Katzen und Hausvögel können auf den meisten Flügen in der Kabine mitreisen, sofern sie die Alters-, Gesundheits- und Zielanforderungen erfüllen. Die Transportbox muss unter den Vordersitz passen, wobei gängige weiche Abmessungen etwa 45,7 x 28 x 28 cm (18 x 11 x 11 Zoll) betragen. Eine vorherige Genehmigung von Delta ist erforderlich.

faqs.q: Welche Regeln gelten für Batterien auf Delta-Flügen?
faqs.a: Ersatz-Lithium-Ionen-Batterien (bis 160 Wh) dürfen nur im Handgepäck mitgeführt und müssen vor Kurzschluss geschützt werden. Batterien über 160 Wh sind stark eingeschränkt oder verboten. Geräte mit Batterien können im Handgepäck oder aufgegebenen Gepäck mitgeführt werden, müssen aber im aufgegebenen Gepäck ausgeschaltet und vor versehentlicher Aktivierung geschützt sein.

faqs.q: Quelles sont les dimensions des bagages à main chez Delta ?
faqs.a: Les bagages à main de Delta ne doivent pas dépasser 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 pouces), y compris les poignées et les roues. Il n'y a généralement pas de limite de poids, sauf indication contraire pour certaines routes internationales.

faqs.q: Puis-je emmener un animal de compagnie en cabine sur Delta ?
faqs.a: Oui, les petits chiens, chats et oiseaux domestiques peuvent voyager en cabine sur la plupart des vols, à condition qu'ils répondent aux exigences d'âge, de santé et de destination. faqs.a: Il bagaglio a mano di Delta non deve superare i 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 pollici), incluse maniglie e ruote. Generalmente non c'è limite di peso a meno che non sia specificato per alcune rotte internazionali.

faqs.q: Posso portare un animale domestico in cabina su Delta?
faqs.a: Sì, cani di piccola taglia, gatti e uccelli domestici possono viaggiare in cabina sulla maggior parte dei voli, a condizione che soddisfino i requisiti di età, salute e destinazione. Il trasportino per animali deve entrare sotto il sedile di fronte a te, con dimensioni comuni per quelli morbidi di circa 45,7 x 28 x 28 cm (18 x 11 x 11 pollici). È richiesta l'approvazione preventiva di Delta.

faqs.q: Quali sono le regole per le batterie sui voli Delta?
faqs.a: Le batterie agli ioni di litio di ricambio (fino a 160 Wh) devono essere solo nel bagaglio a mano e protette da cortocircuito. Le batterie superiori a 160 Wh sono fortemente limitate o proibite. I dispositivi con batterie possono essere nel bagaglio a mano o registrato, ma se nel bagaglio registrato, devono essere spenti e protetti da attivazione accidentale.

allowed_guidelines: 通常、乗客1人につき機内持ち込み手荷物1個と身の回り品1個が許可されています。
機内持ち込みペットは事前の承認が必要で、承認されたキャリーバッグに快適に収まり、座席の下に置ける必要があります。
100 Wh以下のリチウムイオンバッテリーを搭載したほとんどの携帯型電子機器は、機内持ち込み手荷物または受託手荷物（注意事項あり）で許可されています。
strict_restrictions: 機内持ち込み手荷物は、ハンドルと車輪を含め、56 x 36 x 23 cm（22 x 14 x 9インチ）を超えてはなりません。
予備のリチウムイオンバッテリーは常に機内持ち込み手荷物に入れ、短絡から保護する必要があります。
160 Whを超えるリチウムイオンバッテリーは、通常禁止されているか、航空会社の特別な承認が必要です。

faqs.q: デルタ航空の機内持ち込み手荷物の寸法は？
faqs.a: デルタ航空の機内持ち込み手荷物は、ハンドルと車輪を含め、56 x 36 x 23 cm（22 x 14 x 9インチ）を超えてはなりません。特定の国際線で指定されていない限り、通常、重量制限はありません。

faqs.q: デルタ航空の機内にペットを連れて行けますか？
faqs.a: はい、ほとんどのフライトで小型犬、猫、家庭用鳥を機内に連れて行くことができます。ただし、年齢、健康、目的地の要件を満たしている必要があります。ペットキャリーは前の座席の下に収まる必要があり、一般的なソフトタイプの寸法は約45.7 x 28 x 28 cm（18 x 11 x 11インチ）です。デルタ航空の事前の承認が必要です。

faqs.q: デルタ航空のフライトでのバッテリーに関する規則は？
faqs.a: 予備のリチウムイオンバッテリー（160 Whまで）は機内持ち込み手荷物のみで、短絡から保護する必要があります。160 Whを超えるバッテリーは厳しく制限されているか、禁止されています。バッテリーを搭載したデバイスは機内持ち込み手荷物または受託手荷物に入れることができますが、受託手荷物の場合は電源を切り、偶発的な作動から保護する必要があります。

allowed_guidelines: Geralmente, é permitida uma bagagem de mão e um item pessoal por passageiro.
Animais de estimação na cabine exigem aprovação prévia e devem caber confortavelmente em uma transportadora aprovada debaixo do assento.
A maioria dos dispositivos eletrônicos portáteis com baterias de íon-lítio abaixo de 100 Wh são permitidos na bagagem de mão ou despachada (com precauções).
strict_restrictions: As bagagens de mão não devem exceder 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 polegadas), incluindo alças e rodas.
Baterias de íon-lítio sobressalentes devem estar sempre na bagagem de mão e protegidas contra curto-circuito.
Baterias de íon-lítio acima de 160 Wh são geralmente proibidas ou exigem aprovação especial da companhia aérea.

faqs.q: Quais são as dimensões da bagagem de mão da Delta?
faqs.a: A bagagem de mão da Delta não deve exceder 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 polegadas), incluindo alças e rodas. Geralmente não há limite de peso, a menos que especificado para certas rotas internacionais.

faqs.q: Posso levar um animal de estimação na cabine na Delta?
faqs.a: Sim, cães pequenos, gatos e pássaros domésticos podem viajar na cabine na maioria dos voos, desde que atendam aos requisitos de idade, saúde e destino. A transportadora de animais deve caber debaixo do assento à sua frente, com dimensões comuns para as de lado macio em torno de 45,7 x 28 x 28 cm (18 x 11 x 11 polegadas). Aprovação prévia da Delta é necessária.

faqs.q: Quais são as regras para baterias em voos da Delta?
faqs.a: Baterias de íon-lítio sobressalentes (até 160 Wh) devem estar apenas na bagagem de mão e protegidas contra curto-circuito. Baterias acima de 160 Wh são altamente restritas ou proibidas. Dispositivos com baterias podem estar na bagagem de mão ou despachada, mas se na bagagem despachada, devem estar desligados e protegidos contra ativação acidental.

allowed_guidelines: Eén stuk handbagage en één persoonlijk item zijn over het algemeen toegestaan per passagier.
Huisdieren in de cabine vereisen voorafgaande goedkeuring en moeten comfortabel passen in een goedgekeurde draagtas onder de stoel.
De meeste draagbare elektronische apparaten met lithium-ionbatterijen onder 100 Wh zijn toegestaan in handbagage of ruimbagage (met voorzorgsmaatregelen).
strict_restrictions: Handbagage mag niet groter zijn dan 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 inch) inclusief handvatten en wielen.
Reserve lithium-ionbatterijen moeten altijd in de handbagage worden meegenomen en beschermd zijn tegen kortsluiting.
Lithium-ionbatterijen van meer dan 160 Wh zijn over het algemeen verboden of vereisen speciale goedkeuring van de luchtvaartmaatschappij.

faqs.q: Wat zijn de afmetingen van de handbagage bij Delta?
faqs.a: De handbagage van Delta mag niet groter zijn dan 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 inch), inclusief handvatten en wielen. Er is over het algemeen geen gewichtslimiet, tenzij gespecificeerd voor bepaalde internationale routes.

faqs.q: Mag ik een huisdier meenemen in de cabine bij Delta?
faqs.a: Ja, kleine honden, katten en huisvogels mogen op de meeste vluchten in de cabine reizen, mits ze voldoen aan de leeftijd-, gezondheids- en bestemmingsvereisten. De huisdier draagtas moet onder de stoel voor u passen, met gangbare zachte afmetingen van ongeveer 45,7 x 28 x 28 cm (18 x 11 x 11 inch). Voorafgaande goedkeuring van Delta is vereist.

faqs.q: Wat zijn de regels voor batterijen op Delta-vluchten?
faqs.a: Reserve lithium-ionbatterijen (tot 160 Wh) mogen alleen in de handbagage worden meegenomen en moeten beschermd zijn tegen kortsluiting. Batterijen van meer dan 160 Wh zijn sterk beperkt of verboden. Apparaten met batterijen kunnen in de handbagage of ruimbagage, maar als ze in de ruimbagage zitten, moeten ze volledig zijn uitgeschakeld en beschermd zijn tegen onbedoelde activering.

allowed_guidelines: One personal item (43 x 25 x 22 cm / 17 x 10 x 9 in) is allowed for all tickets, including Basic Economy.
One standard carry-on bag (56 x 35 x 22 cm / 22 x 14 x 9 in) is allowed for most tickets, except Basic Economy.
Lithium batteries under 100 Wh are generally permitted in carry-on or checked baggage (installed in devices) or carry-on only (spare).
strict_restrictions: Basic Economy tickets generally do not include a standard carry-on bag, only a personal item. Exceptions apply for MileagePlus Premier members, qualifying United credit cardholders, or Star Alliance Gold members.
Lithium batteries over 160 Wh are strictly prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage.
Smart luggage with non-removable batteries exceeding specific limits is not allowed.
E-cigarettes and vaping devices are only allowed in carry-on baggage.

faqs.q: What are the personal item dimensions for United Airlines?
faqs.a: Your personal item must not exceed 43 x 25 x 22 cm (17 x 10 x 9 inches) and must fit under the seat in front of you.

faqs.q: Can I bring a carry-on bag with a Basic Economy ticket on United?

en.title: American Airlines Compatibility Matrix: Carry-on, Personal Item, Pet & Electronics
en.summary: Detailed specifications for carry-on bags, personal items, cabin pet travel, and electronics on American Airlines flights. Ensure your items comply with regulations for a smooth journey.
en.amazon_search_query: American Airlines carry-on bag underseat pet carrier
en.buy_box_title: Recommended Travel Gear for American Airlines
en.buy_box_subtitle: Shop compliant bags and accessories for your next flight.
allowed_guidelines: One carry-on bag and one personal item are generally allowed per passenger.
Small pets (dogs/cats) can travel in the cabin if they fit under the seat in an approved carrier.
Portable electronic devices and spare lithium batteries (within limits) must be carried in carry-on baggage.
strict_restrictions: Carry-on bags exceeding 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) are not allowed in the cabin.
Personal items must fit completely under the seat in front of you.
Pets and their carriers exceeding 20 lbs (9.07 kg) combined weight are not allowed in the cabin.
Lithium-ion batteries over 160 Wh are prohibited. Spare batteries must be in carry-on only.

faqs.q: What are the carry-on bag dimensions for American Airlines?
faqs.a: American Airlines allows one carry-on bag with maximum dimensions of 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm), including handles and wheels. There is no official weight limit, but it must fit in the overhead bin and be liftable by the passenger.

faqs.q: Can I bring a pet in the cabin on American Airlines?
faqs.a: Yes, small dogs and cats can travel in the cabin on American Airlines, provided they fit comfortably in an approved carrier under the seat in front of you. The combined weight of the pet and carrier must not exceed 20 lbs (9.07 kg).

faqs.q: What are the rules for power banks and lithium batteries on American Airlines?
faqs.a: Power banks and spare lithium-ion batteries must be carried in your carry-on baggage only; they are not allowed in checked baggage. Batteries under 100 Wh are generally permitted, while those between 100-160 Wh require airline approval (max 2 spare batteries). Batteries over 160 Wh are prohibited.

allowed_guidelines: Ein Handgepäckstück und ein persönlicher Gegenstand sind pro Passagier generell erlaubt.
Kleine Haustiere (Hunde/Katzen) dürfen in der Kabine reisen, wenn sie in einer zugelassenen Transportbox unter den Sitz passen.
Tragbare elektronische Geräte und Ersatz-Lithiumbatterien (innerhalb der Grenzen) müssen im Handgepäck mitgeführt werden.
strict_restrictions: Handgepäck, das 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 Zoll) überschreitet, ist in der Kabine nicht erlaubt.
Persönliche Gegenstände müssen vollständig unter den Vordersitz passen.
Haustiere und ihre Transportboxen, die zusammen 9,07 kg (20 lbs) überschreiten, sind in der Kabine nicht erlaubt.
Lithium-Ionen-Akkus über 160 Wh sind verboten. Ersatzakkus dürfen nur im Handgepäck mitgeführt werden.

faqs.q: Welche Maße gelten für Handgepäck bei American Airlines?
faqs.a: American Airlines erlaubt ein Handgepäckstück mit maximalen Maßen von 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 Zoll), einschließlich Griffen und Rollen. Es gibt keine offizielle Gewichtsbeschränkung, aber es muss ins Gepäckfach passen und vom Passagier anhebbar sein.

faqs.q: Darf ich ein Haustier in der Kabine von American Airlines mitnehmen?
faqs.a: Ja, kleine Hunde und Katzen dürfen in der Kabine von American Airlines reisen, vorausgesetzt, sie passen bequem in eine zugelassene Transportbox unter den Vordersitz. Das Gesamtgewicht von Haustier und Transportbox darf 9,07 kg (20 lbs) nicht überschreiten.

faqs.q: Welche Regeln gelten für Powerbanks und Lithiumbatterien bei American Airlines?
faqs.a: Powerbanks und Ersatz-Lithium-Ionen-Akkus dürfen nur im Handgepäck mitgeführt werden; sie sind im aufgegebenen Gepäck nicht erlaubt. Akkus unter 100 Wh sind generell erlaubt, während solche zwischen 100-160 Wh die Genehmigung der Fluggesellschaft erfordern (max. 2 Ersatzakkus). Akkus über 160 Wh sind verboten.

Les appareils électroniques portables et les batteries au lithium de rechange (dans les limites) doivent être transportés en bagage à main.
strict_restrictions: Les bagages à main dépassant 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 pouces) ne sont pas autorisés en cabine.
Les articles personnels doivent tenir entièrement sous le siège devant vous.
Les animaux de compagnie et leurs cages dépassant un poids combiné de 9,07 kg (20 lbs) ne sont pas autorisés en cabine.
Les batteries lithium-ion de plus de 160 Wh sont interdites. Les batteries de rechange doivent être uniquement en bagage à main.

faqs.q: Quelles sont les dimensions des bagages à main pour American Airlines?
faqs.a: American Airlines autorise un bagage à main avec des dimensions maximales de 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 pouces), poignées et roues comprises. Il n'y a pas de limite de poids officielle, mais il doit tenir dans le compartiment supérieur et être soulevable par le passager.

faqs.q: Puis-je emmener un animal de compagnie en cabine sur American Airlines?
faqs.a: Oui, les petits chiens et chats peuvent voyager en cabine sur American Airlines, à condition qu'ils tiennent confortablement dans une cage approuvée sous le siège devant vous. Le poids combiné de l'animal et de la cage ne doit pas dépasser 9,07 kg (20 lbs).

faqs.q: Quelles sont les règles pour les batteries externes et les batteries au lithium sur American Airlines?
faqs.a: Les batteries externes et les batteries lithium-ion de rechange doivent être transportées uniquement dans votre bagage à main; elles ne sont pas autorisées en soute. Les batteries de moins de 100 Wh sont généralement autorisées, tandis que celles entre 100 et 160 Wh nécessitent l'approbation de la compagnie aérienne (max. 2 batteries de rechange). Les batteries de plus de 160 Wh sont interdites.

faqs.q: ¿Cuáles son las dimensiones del equipaje de mano para American Airlines?
faqs.a: American Airlines permite un equipaje de mano con dimensiones máximas de 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 pulgadas), incluyendo asas y ruedas. No hay límite de peso oficial, pero debe caber en el compartimento superior y ser levantable por el pasajero.

faqs.q: ¿Puedo llevar una mascota en la cabina de American Airlines?
faqs.a: Sí, los perros y gatos pequeños pueden viajar en la cabina de American Airlines, siempre que quepan cómodamente en un transportín aprobado debajo del asiento delantero. El peso combinado de la mascota y el transportín no debe exceder los 9,07 kg (20 lbs).

faqs.q: ¿Cuáles son las reglas para las baterías externas y las baterías de litio en American Airlines?
faqs.a: Las baterías externas y las baterías de iones de litio de repuesto deben llevarse únicamente en su equipaje de mano; no están permitidas en el equipaje facturado. faqs.q: Quali sono le dimensioni del bagaglio a mano per American Airlines?
faqs.a: American Airlines consente un bagaglio a mano con dimensioni massime di 56 x 36 x 23 cm (22 x 14 x 9 pollici), incluse maniglie e ruote. Non c'è un limite di peso ufficiale, ma deve entrare nella cappelliera ed essere sollevabile dal passeggero.

faqs.q: Posso portare un animale domestico in cabina su American Airlines?
faqs.a: Sì, cani e gatti di piccola taglia possono viaggiare in cabina su American Airlines, a condizione che si adattino comodamente in un trasportino approvato sotto il sedile di fronte a te. Il peso combinato dell'animale e del trasportino non deve superare i 9,07 kg (20 lbs).

faqs.q: Quali sono le regole per i power bank e le batterie al litio su American Airlines?

allowed_guidelines: 通常、乗客1名につき機内持ち込み手荷物1個と身の回り品1個が許可されています。
小型のペット（犬／猫）は、承認されたケージに入れて座席の下に収まる場合、機内で旅行できます。
携帯型電子機器および予備のリチウム電池（制限内）は、機内持ち込み手荷物として携帯する必要があります。
strict_restrictions: 22 x 14 x 9インチ（56 x 36 x 23 cm）を超える機内持ち込み手荷物は機内では許可されません。
身の回り品は、前の座席の下に完全に収まる必要があります。
ペットとケージの合計重量が20ポンド（9.07 kg）を超える場合は、機内では許可されません。
160 Whを超えるリチウムイオン電池は禁止されています。予備電池は機内持ち込みのみです。

faqs.q: アメリカン航空の機内持ち込み手荷物の寸法は？
faqs.a: アメリカン航空では、ハンドルと車輪を含め、最大寸法が22 x 14 x 9インチ（56 x 36 x 23 cm）の機内持ち込み手荷物1個が許可されています。公式な重量制限はありませんが、頭上の収納棚に収まり、乗客が持ち上げられる必要があります。

faqs.q: アメリカン航空の機内にペットを連れて行けますか？
faqs.a: はい、小型犬と猫はアメリカン航空の機内で旅行できます。ただし、承認されたケージに快適に収まり、前の座席の下に置ける場合に限ります。ペットとケージの合計重量は20ポンド（9.07 kg）を超えてはなりません。

faqs.q: アメリカン航空でのモバイルバッテリーとリチウム電池の規則は？
faqs.a: モバイルバッテリーと予備のリチウムイオン電池は、機内持ち込み手荷物としてのみ携帯する必要があります。受託手荷物としては許可されません。100 Wh未満の電池は通常許可されていますが、100～160 Whの電池は航空会社の承認が必要です（予備電池は最大2個）。160 Whを超える電池は禁止されています。

faqs.q: Posso levar um animal de estimação na cabine da American Airlines?
faqs.a: Sim, cães e gatos pequenos podem viajar na cabine da American Airlines, desde que caibam confortavelmente em um transportador aprovado sob o assento à sua frente. O peso combinado do animal e do transportador não deve exceder 9,07 kg (20 lbs).

faqs.q: Quais são as regras para power banks e baterias de lítio na American Airlines?

faqs.q: Mag ik een huisdier meenemen in de cabine van American Airlines?

faqs.q: Wat zijn de regels voor powerbanks en lithiumbatterijen bij American Airlines?

faqs.q: What are the carry-on dimensions for Qatar Airways Economy Class?
faqs.a: For Economy Class, Qatar Airways allows one piece of carry-on baggage with maximum dimensions of 50 x 37 x 25 cm (19.7 x 14.6 x 9.8 inches) and a maximum weight of 7 kg (15.4 lbs).

faqs.q: Can I bring a power bank on Qatar Airways?
faqs.a: Yes, power banks are allowed in carry-on baggage only. Those up to 100 Wh are generally permitted without approval. Power banks between 101-160 Wh require airline approval and are limited to two per passenger. Power banks over 160 Wh are prohibited.

faqs.q: Is a personal item allowed in addition to carry-on baggage?
faqs.a: Yes, passengers are typically allowed to bring one personal item, such as a laptop bag, handbag, or small backpack, in addition to their standard carry-on baggage. It must be small enough to fit under the seat in front of you.

en.title: Samsung Neo QLED & OLED TV VESA Compatibility & Measurements (55/65/75 inch)
en.summary: Comprehensive compatibility matrix for Samsung Neo QLED and OLED TVs (55, 65, 75 inch models), including VESA patterns, screw specifications, weight, and dimensions for safe mounting and installation.
en.amazon_search_query: Samsung Neo QLED OLED TV VESA mount 55 65 75 inch
en.buy_box_title: Find the Perfect VESA Mount for Your Samsung TV
en.buy_box_subtitle: Ensure secure installation with compatible wall mounts and accessories.
allowed_guidelines: Always refer to your specific TV model's user manual for the most accurate VESA specifications and screw length recommendations.
Ensure your chosen VESA mount has a weight capacity exceeding the TV's weight (including any attached accessories).
Use M8 screws with a length of 10-12mm, ensuring they do not bottom out or are too short. Spacers may be required.
Distribute weight evenly when mounting to prevent stress on the TV's mounting points.
strict_restrictions: Do NOT use screws longer than 13mm into the TV's VESA holes, as this can cause internal damage.
Do NOT use VESA mounts that do not match the TV's specified pattern (e.g., 200x200, 400x300, 400x400).
Do NOT exceed the maximum weight capacity of your chosen wall mount.
Avoid overtightening screws, which can strip threads or crack the TV's casing.

faqs.q: What VESA pattern do Samsung Neo QLED and OLED TVs use?
faqs.a: Samsung Neo QLED and OLED TVs typically use VESA patterns such as 200x200mm (for some 55-inch models), 400x300mm (for 55-inch and 65-inch models), and 400x400mm (for 65-inch and 75-inch models). Always check your specific model's manual for exact details.

faqs.q: What size screws do I need for my Samsung TV VESA mount?
faqs.a: Most Samsung Neo QLED and OLED TVs require M8 screws. The recommended length is typically 10-12mm, but it's crucial to verify this in your TV's user manual to avoid damaging internal components. Do not insert screws deeper than 13mm.

faqs.q: How much does a 65-inch Samsung Neo QLED TV weigh?
faqs.a: A 65-inch Samsung Neo QLED TV (e.g., QN90C) typically weighs around 24.4 kg (53.8 lbs) without its stand. OLED models (e.g., S90C) of the same size might be slightly lighter, around 20.9 kg (46.1 lbs). Always check the exact weight for your model and ensure your wall mount can support it.

faqs.q: Welches VESA-Muster verwenden Samsung Neo QLED und OLED Fernseher?

faqs.q: Wie viel wiegt ein 65-Zoll Samsung Neo QLED Fernseher?

faqs.q: Is de GoPro Hero 13 Black momenteel beschikbaar?
faqs.a: Vanaf de laatste update is de GoPro Hero 13 Black nog niet officieel uitgebracht. De specificaties die voor Hero 13 worden vermeld, zijn gebaseerd op de verwachte continuïteit met de Hero 12 Black.

faqs.q: Wat is de maximaal aanbevolen microSD-kaartgrootte voor Hero 12 Black?
faqs.a: GoPro raadt officieel microSD-kaarten tot 512 GB aan voor optimale en geverifieerde prestaties. Grotere kaarten kunnen werken, maar worden niet officieel ondersteund.

faqs.q: Kan ik oudere GoPro-batterijen gebruiken met de Hero 12 Black?
faqs.a: De Hero 12 Black is ontworpen voor de Enduro-batterij (1720 mAh) voor optimale prestaties, vooral bij koud weer. Oudere batterijen passen mogelijk wel, maar bieden mogelijk niet dezelfde prestaties of batterijduur.

en.title: DJI Mini 4 Pro & Air 3 Compatibility and Measurement Matrix
en.summary: Comprehensive compatibility and exact measurement matrix for DJI Mini 4 Pro and DJI Air 3 drones, covering key hardware specifications, regulatory compliance, and operational details.

en.buy_box_title: Find Compatible Accessories for Your DJI Drone
en.buy_box_subtitle: Explore recommended microSD cards, charging solutions, and carrying cases.
allowed_guidelines: Use Class 10 or UHS-I Speed Grade 3 microSD cards for optimal performance.
Ensure proper battery charging with recommended power adapters (30W for Mini 4 Pro, 65W for Air 3 hub).
Operate within specified temperature ranges (-10°C to 40°C / 14°F to 104°F) for optimal performance and safety.
strict_restrictions: Do not exceed local drone weight regulations (e.g., <250g for Mini 4 Pro in many regions; Air 3 requires registration).
Avoid using non-certified third-party batteries or charging equipment.
Do not operate outside specified operating temperature range, as it may affect drone performance and battery life.

faqs.q: What is the main weight difference between Mini 4 Pro and Air 3?
faqs.a: The DJI Mini 4 Pro weighs less than 249g (0.55 lbs), making it exempt from registration in many regions, while the DJI Air 3 weighs 720g (1.59 lbs) and typically requires registration.

faqs.q: Can I use the same remote controller for both drones?
faqs.a: Yes, both DJI Mini 4 Pro and Air 3 are compatible with the DJI RC 2 and DJI RC-N2 remote controllers, utilizing the O4 video transmission system.

faqs.q: What type of microSD card is recommended for these drones?
faqs.a: Both drones require a Class 10 or UHS-I Speed Grade 3 (U3) microSD card for optimal video recording performance and data transfer speeds.

allowed_guidelines: Verwenden Sie microSD-Karten der Klasse 10 oder UHS-I Speed Grade 3 für optimale Leistung.
Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Batterien ordnungsgemäß mit den empfohlenen Netzteilen geladen werden (30W für Mini 4 Pro, 65W für Air 3 Hub).
Betreiben Sie die Drohne innerhalb der angegebenen Temperaturbereiche (-10°C bis 40°C / 14°F bis 104°F) für optimale Leistung und Sicherheit.

Betreiben Sie die Drohne nicht außerhalb des angegebenen Betriebstemperaturbereichs, da dies die Drohnenleistung und Batterielebensdauer beeinträchtigen kann.

faqs.q: Was ist der Hauptgewichts-Unterschied zwischen Mini 4 Pro und Air 3?
faqs.a: Die DJI Mini 4 Pro wiegt weniger als 249g (0,55 lbs) und ist daher in vielen Regionen von der Registrierung befreit, während die DJI Air 3 720g (1,59 lbs) wiegt und in der Regel eine Registrierung erfordert.

faqs.q: Kann ich dieselbe Fernsteuerung für beide Drohnen verwenden?
faqs.a: Ja, sowohl DJI Mini 4 Pro als auch Air 3 sind mit den Fernsteuerungen DJI RC 2 und DJI RC-N2 kompatibel und nutzen das O4-Videoübertragungssystem.

faqs.q: Welk type microSD-kaart moet ik kopen voor mijn Steam Deck OLED?
faqs.a: Voor de beste ervaring wordt een microSD-kaart met een A2 (Application Performance Class 2) classificatie aanbevolen. Dit zorgt voor snellere laadtijden voor games en applicaties.

faqs.q: Can I use any external SSD with the Xbox Series X?
faqs.a: You can use USB 3.1 external SSDs for storing and playing Xbox One, Xbox 360, and Original Xbox games. For Xbox Series X|S optimized games, you must use the proprietary Seagate Storage Expansion Card.

faqs.a: You need an Ultra High Speed HDMI cable (HDMI 2.1 certified) to achieve 4K at 120Hz. The console includes one.

faqs.q: Can the Xbox Series X play 8K content?
faqs.a: Yes, the Xbox Series X supports 8K output at 60Hz, though 8K gaming is not currently a primary focus.

faqs.q: Kan ik elke externe SSD gebruiken met de Xbox Series X?
faqs.a: Je kunt USB 3.1 externe SSD's gebruiken voor het opslaan en spelen van Xbox One, Xbox 360 en Original Xbox games. Voor Xbox Series X|S geoptimaliseerde games moet je de eigen Seagate Storage Expansion Card gebruiken.

faqs.q: Welke HDMI-kabel heb ik nodig voor 4K 120Hz?
faqs.a: Je hebt een Ultra High Speed HDMI-kabel (HDMI 2.1 gecertificeerd) nodig om 4K op 120Hz te bereiken. De console wordt geleverd met één.

faqs.q: Kan de Xbox Series X 8K-content afspelen?
faqs.a: Ja, de Xbox Series X ondersteunt 8K-uitvoer op 60Hz, hoewel 8K-gaming momenteel geen primaire focus is.
